# Markdown Lens

> Markdown Lens is a free, privacy-first PDF and Word-to-Markdown converter with an online Markdown editor and GitHub-style preview.

- [Markdown Lens](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/): Product overview, document conversion, privacy details, supported syntax, and links to the editor.
- [PDF to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/pdf-to-markdown): Convert selectable text from PDF files into editable Markdown locally, with page markers, inferred headings and lists, and explicit limitations.
- [Word to Markdown Converter](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/word-to-markdown): Convert modern Word .docx files into Markdown locally while retaining headings, lists, links, simple tables, and common formatting.
- [Open the Markdown Editor](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/editor): Paste, edit, import, preview, copy, download, export, and print Markdown in a web browser.
- [Markdown Cheatsheet](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/markdown-cheatsheet): Examples of headings, lists, task lists, tables, code blocks, Mermaid diagrams, and math.
- [Full Product Reference](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed capabilities, privacy behavior, supported syntax, and common questions.
- [Open-source Repository](https://github.com/ayushhagarwal/markdown-lens): Source code, issues, license, and contribution information.

## Key facts

- Free and open source.
- No account required.
- Markdown, text-based PDF, and Word .docx documents are processed in the browser.
- Draft autosave uses local browser storage.
- Document content is not uploaded to a Markdown Lens backend.
- Text-based PDF and Word .docx files up to 100 MB can be converted to editable Markdown.
- Scanned PDFs need OCR, legacy .doc files must be saved as .docx, and embedded images are not extracted.
- Supports GitHub-flavored Markdown, Mermaid, KaTeX math, and syntax-highlighted code.
